name: Kihijo
source: Director of the Monazite Tourism Committee. He left Monazite to go to college, and founded the Tourism Committee after he returned. Many citizens of Monazite consider Kihijo an outsider.
translation: Director of the Monazite Tourism Committee. He left Monazite to go to college, and founded the Tourism Committee after he returned. Many citizens of Monazite consider Kihijo an outsider.
